Engine **0.22.0**, policy `ats-v2+6e295cb1`, 35 rules. This page is built from
`policyRubric(DEFAULT_POLICY)` when the docs are built, so it always matches the installed engine.
Call `policyRubric(policy)` yourself to get the same table for a policy of your own.

- **Score.** Each rule that applies can lose its weight. The readiness score is the share of the
  applicable weight kept, 0–100. A rule whose evidence is absent (page geometry for pasted text, a
  posting for the copied-posting check) is left out of both the report and the score.
- **Deductions.** Integrity rules (`−n pts`) come off the finished score in points and are never part
  of the weighing: an honest resume scores exactly as if they did not exist.
- **Determinism.** The same input, reference date (`now`), engine version and policy fingerprint
  always give the same report. Every report carries `engine.version` and `engine.policy`.
- **Writing rules** read English only. For a resume in another language they drop out instead of
  judging it on English words.

See [Scoring and the rubric](/ats-engine/concepts/scoring) for how the score is put together.

## Integrity

6 rules, up to 115 points deducted in all.

| Rule                                   | Severity | Reads               | Weight  | Passes when                                 | Fix                                                                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ats-v2.integrity.promptInjection`     | error    | injectionPhrases    | −30 pts | No instructions aimed at an AI screener.    | Remove it. Recruiters and screening tools treat instructions to an AI as manipulation, and many reject the application on sight.             |
| `ats-v2.integrity.hiddenText`          | error    | hiddenTextChars     | −30 pts | No hidden text.                             | Remove hidden text. White or tiny text and text behind an image is read by the ATS and treated as keyword stuffing once a recruiter sees it. |
| `ats-v2.integrity.copiedPosting`       | error    | copiedPostingRatio  | −25 pts | The resume is not a copy of the posting.    | Describe your own experience. A pasted posting is caught the moment a recruiter reads the resume.                                            |
| `ats-v2.integrity.invisibleCharacters` | warning  | invisibleCharacters | −10 pts | No invisible characters.                    | Remove zero-width and other invisible characters; retype any word they split.                                                                |
| `ats-v2.integrity.homoglyphs`          | warning  | homoglyphWords      | −10 pts | No look-alike letters from other alphabets. | Retype those words: they look right but no search matches them.                                                                              |
| `ats-v2.integrity.keywordStuffing`     | warning  | stuffedTerms        | −10 pts | No keyword stuffing.                        | Name each skill where you used it. Repetition does not raise a match score in a modern ATS, and recruiters read it as stuffing.              |

## Parsing

5 rules, 68 points of weight.

| Rule                            | Severity | Reads               | Weight | Passes when                                                           | Fix                                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ats-v2.parse.text`             | error    | at least 50 words   | 20     | Recovered {n} words of text.                                          | Save the resume as a text-based PDF rather than a scan or an image.               |
| `ats-v2.parse.imageOnly`        | error    | imageOnlyPages      | 15     | Every page has a text layer.                                          | Export the resume as a text PDF rather than scanning it or saving it as an image. |
| `ats-v2.parse.roles`            | error    | rolesDetected       | 15     | {n} roles were recovered from the work history.                       | Give each job a line with the title, the employer, and a date range.              |
| `ats-v2.parse.roleCompleteness` | warning  | roleCompleteness    | 10     | {pct}% of recovered roles have a title, an employer and a start date. | Make sure every job lists a title, an employer, and a date range.                 |
| `ats-v2.parse.contact`          | warning  | contactCompleteness | 8      | {pct}% of the expected contact fields were recovered.                 | Include a name, an email address, and a phone number as plain text.               |

## Contact & links

3 rules, 20 points of weight.

| Rule                         | Severity | Reads                            | Weight | Passes when                                          | Fix                                                                                                                                                         |
| ---------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ats-v2.contact.email`       | error    | a pattern, in the document       | 12     | An email address was found.                          | Add an email address at the top of the first page, as plain text in the body rather than in a page header.                                                  |
| `ats-v2.contact.position`    | warning  | contact details in the first 25% | 6      | Contact details appear near the top of the document. | Put the email address and phone number at the top of the first page, in the body of the document rather than in a page header, which many ATS parsers skip. |
| `ats-v2.privacy.dateOfBirth` | info     | dateOfBirthStated                | 2      | No date of birth is stated.                          | Leave your date of birth off unless the country you are applying in expects it.                                                                             |

## Evidence

5 rules, 29 points of weight.

| Rule                           | Severity | Reads             | Weight | Passes when                                                  | Fix                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------ | -------- | ----------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `ats-v2.content.metrics`       | warning  | metricsRatio      | 10     | {pct}% of content lines carry a number.                      | Quantify outcomes: amounts, percentages, timeframes, headcounts.                                              |
| `ats-v2.content.verbs`         | warning  | actionVerbRatio   | 8      | {pct}% of bullets name an action you took.                   | Make each bullet say what you did, with an action word ("Led", "Built", "Cut"), rather than what the job was. |
| `ats-v2.content.buzzwords`     | info     | buzzwordCount     | 5      | Little filler language.                                      | Replace filler phrases with a specific thing you did.                                                         |
| `ats-v2.content.timeline`      | info     | timelineIssues    | 3      | The dates in the work history are consistent.                | Check the dates: a role cannot start after today, and an end date left off makes jobs overlap.                |
| `ats-v2.content.skillEvidence` | info     | unsupportedSkills | 3      | Most listed skills are backed by the work they were used in. | Name each key skill in the role or project where you used it, not only in the list.                           |

## Format risk

5 rules, 45 points of weight.

| Rule                          | Severity | Reads             | Weight | Passes when                                   | Fix                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------- | -------- | ----------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ats-v2.format.length`        | warning  | wordCount         | 10     | The resume is {n} words, a reasonable length. | Keep the resume between about 200 and 1,500 words: one or two pages.                 |
| `ats-v2.format.letterSpacing` | warning  | letterSpacedLines | 8      | Headings extract as whole words.              | Remove the letter spacing (tracking) from section headings so they extract as words. |
| `ats-v2.format.columns`       | error    | columnRatio       | 15     | The document reads as a single column.        | Use a single-column layout; columns extract in a scrambled order.                    |
| `ats-v2.format.tables`        | warning  | tableCount        | 10     | No ruled tables were found.                   | Replace tables with plain paragraphs and bullets.                                    |
| `ats-v2.format.photo`         | info     | imageCount        | 2      | No photo was found.                           | Leave the photo off unless the country you are applying in expects one.              |

## Writing

8 rules, 12 points of weight.

| Rule                             | Severity | Reads                       | Weight | Passes when                                     | Fix                                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------- | -------- | --------------------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ats-v2.writing.firstPerson`     | info     | firstPersonLines (en only)  | 2      | No bullet speaks in the first person.           | Leave out "I", "my" and "we": open each bullet with what you did ("Led the payments team").                  |
| `ats-v2.writing.passiveVoice`    | info     | passiveVoiceRatio (en only) | 2      | Most bullets are in the active voice.           | Say who acted: "Rebuilt the payments service in Go", not "The payments service was rebuilt".                 |
| `ats-v2.writing.weakOpeners`     | warning  | weakOpeners (en only)       | 2      | Bullets open with an action rather than a duty. | Replace "Responsible for", "Worked on" and the like with the verb for what you did, and say what came of it. |
| `ats-v2.writing.tense`           | info     | tenseMismatches (en only)   | 2      | Past roles are written in the past tense.       | Write roles you have left in the past tense ("Led", not "Lead"). The role you hold now can use either.       |
| `ats-v2.writing.bulletLength`    | info     | longBullets (en only)       | 1      | No bullet runs past two lines.                  | Keep each bullet to one or two lines, one action and its result; split a longer one in two.                  |
| `ats-v2.writing.bulletsPerRole`  | info     | bulletsPerRole (en only)    | 1      | Each role has a readable number of bullets.     | Give each role two to eight bullets: enough to show what you did, few enough to read.                        |
| `ats-v2.writing.repeatedOpeners` | info     | repeatedOpeners (en only)   | 1      | Bullets in a row open with different words.     | Vary the opening verbs, so each bullet reads as its own result rather than one duty repeated.                |
| `ats-v2.writing.dateFormats`     | info     | dateFormats (en only)       | 1      | Role dates are written one way throughout.      | Write every date the same way, such as "Jan 2020 – Mar 2023".                                                |
